mapper.sql: id, gmt_create, creator_id, instance_id, status, last_heartbeat
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM retry_sharding
AND creator_id LIKE ('%' || #{creatorId} || '%')
AND instance_id LIKE ('%' || #{instanceId} || '%')
ORDER BY id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retry_sharding
AND creator_id LIKE ('%' || #{creatorId} || '%')
AND instance_id LIKE ('%' || #{instanceId} || '%')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT instance_id) FROM retry_sharding WHERE last_heartbeat > SYSDATE - NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{timeoutSeconds}, 'SECOND') AND instance_id IS NOT NULL AND instance_id != ''
SELECT instance_id AS "instanceId", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM retry_sharding WHERE instance_id IS NOT NULL AND instance_id != '' GROUP BY instance_id

SELECT instance_id AS "instanceId", last_heartbeat AS "lastHeartbeat", (SYSDATE - last_heartbeat) * 86400 AS "heartbeatDelay" FROM retry_sharding WHERE instance_id IS NOT NULL AND instance_id != '' ORDER BY last_heartbeat DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM retry_sharding WHERE id = #{id} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM retry_task WHERE retry_task.sharding_key = retry_sharding.id AND ( retry_task.status = 0 OR retry_task.status = 1 OR (retry_task.status = 3 AND retry_task.retry_num > 0) ) )
